services.name: Dental Consultation & Oral Examination
services.description: Comprehensive clinical evaluation of teeth, gums, and oral structures with personalized treatment planning.

services.name: Teeth Cleaning / Scaling
services.description: Professional plaque, tartar, and surface stain removal to prevent gum infections and support oral hygiene.

services.name: Dental Fillings
services.description: Tooth-colored composite and restorative fillings to repair cavities, restore tooth integrity, and prevent decay.

services.name: Root Canal Treatment (RCT)
services.description: Gentle endodontic treatment to treat infection inside the pulp, eliminate toothache, and preserve natural teeth.

services.name: Tooth Extraction
services.description: Careful removal of severely decayed, broken, or impacted teeth with local anesthesia and post-op care guidance.

services.name: Crowns & Bridges
services.description: Durable custom caps and dental bridges to strengthen weak teeth, replace missing teeth, and restore chewing function.

services.name: Dentures (Complete & Partial)
services.description: Custom-fitted removable prostheses crafted to restore comfort, speech, and natural facial aesthetics for missing teeth.

services.name: Braces / Orthodontic Care
services.description: Orthodontic evaluation and teeth alignment solutions for crowded teeth, spacing issues, and bite correction.

services.name: Teeth Whitening
services.description: Professional dental cosmetic whitening procedures to lighten stubborn stains and enhance your natural smile brightness.

services.name: Children's Dental Care
services.description: Gentle, reassuring dental examinations, cavity prevention, and habit guidance tailored specifically for young patients.

services.name: Gum Care & Periodontics
services.description: Targeted therapy for bleeding gums, gingivitis, and periodontitis to safeguard tooth stability and gum health.

services.name: Dental Implants Consultation
services.description: Clinical evaluation and prosthetic planning for permanent replacement of missing teeth using biocompatible titanium roots.

reviews.comment: Visited for a dental check-up and teeth cleaning. The clinic is located right opposite Vikasa School in Vinobanagar, making it very easy to locate. Very clean environment and gentle treatment.
Very polite behavior and honest explanation of what treatment was actually needed. Appointment booking was smooth and waiting time was minimal.
Had severe toothache and consulted here. The procedure was explained thoroughly before starting. Convenient location in Vinobanagar near the police chowki.
